# Blueprint nodes

<div class="gen-note">Generated from the APS 3.0 source code: every name, pin, default and description below is read from the plugin itself, so it matches what you see in the editor.</div>

Every APS node you can place in a Blueprint graph, grouped by where it lives. **Green** nodes are pure (no white execution pins: they only read), **blue** nodes do something, **red** ones are events you override. Pins are coloured as in the editor. Search this page with [[Ctrl]] + [[F]], or the site search above: every node is in it.

## APS Core
The component on every AI. Its nodes read what the AI believes and change how it behaves. Drag from an APS Core reference, or right-click in its owner's graph and type the node's name.

## APS Perception Listener
Put your reactions in a Blueprint made from APS Perception Listener and add it to every AI that should share them. These are the events you implement there.

## Smell Sense
<p class="inert-why"><b>Not reachable from Blueprint in APS 3.0.</b> This is on the Smell Sense object the APS Core creates, and no node returns it. For one kind of AI with its own wind, set <b>Wind Direction</b> in the Class Defaults of a Blueprint child of Smell Sense; for everyone, <b>Set Wind State</b> on the APS Subsystem.</p>
